findings.issue: `hasCommitRecord()` accepts any current-phase `commit_sha` equal to `HEAD` before checking whether `HEAD` is only a same-phase tracking-artifact commit. In the same-root layout, a file-changing phase can record the phase-result/evidence tracking commit itself as the implementation commit and pass the gate, even though the required implementation commit is missing or should be `HEAD^`. This leaves the commit-record gate forgeable for the exact ordering the build-code handoff documents.
findings.recommendation: For `commit_intent:"file_changes"`, reject `sha === HEAD` when `HEAD` is a same-phase tracking-artifact-only commit. Accept `HEAD^` only when `HEAD` is that same-phase tracking commit, and add a regression test where `commit_records[0].commit_sha` points at a tracking-only `HEAD` commit and must fail.

resolutionSummary: revise_required. Targeted tests passed (`npm test -- tests/phase-gate.test.mjs tests/facts-subschema.test.mjs tests/verify-code-capture.test.mjs tests/receipt-verification.test.mjs`, 103 tests) and `git diff --check` passed, but the phase gate still allows a tracking-only HEAD commit to satisfy a file-changing phase commit record.

findings.description: Spec describes or requires eliminating internal contradictions between field contracts or rule statements (cluster A: schema/contract terms + cluster B: conflict/contradiction/duplicate terms). Multiple conflicting schemas for the same entity cause silent drift — schema-drift blocking.
